subject: Exploring embedded Redwood runtime in LumenAI — commercial & technical kickoff

Cc: michael.dunn@lumenai.com
Date: 2026-11-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Opportunity: embed Redwood runtime into LumenAI Insights

Hi Vanessa,

We met briefly at CONV-Connect and I wanted to follow up about embedding Redwood’s runtime into LumenAI Insights (our enterprise analytics UI). Our product team is keen on tight latency and on-premise install options — some customers require white-labeling the UI and shipping a bundled inference runtime.

High-level asks from our side:
- Licensing model: we prefer a per-seat royalty or % rev share rather than flat infra billing for the first 12 months.
- Branding: ability to rebrand UI strings + co-branded legal copy; minimal Redwood breadcrumbs.
- Telemetry/observability: customers demand only aggregate metrics and no PII export — can Redwood run with local telemetry and opt-in reports?
- Pilot: 3-month pilot with a single EU customer (on-prem).

Attaching a one-pager on LumenAI Insights and a short product context doc. Can we schedule a kickoff next week with your partnerships and SEs? Copying Michael (PM) for calendar availability.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Strategic Partnerships
LumenAI

Subject: Redwood embedding — proposed technical approach (pre-kickoff notes)

Hi Elena/Michael — sharing a short pre-read so our kickoff is productive. Key points:

1) Deployment modes we recommend:
   - Private (customer-managed) installer: runtime, model artifacts, KV cache; handles on-prem EU installs.
   - Hybrid: inference stays in customer VPC; control plane for billing/rollout can be optional (we support offline mode).

2) Telemetry / privacy:
   - Default: local telemetry only (aggregate token counts, latency percentiles).
   - Optional: scheduled telemetry bundles (signed, scrubbed) uploaded to partner bucket if customer consents.

3) Branding / UX:
   - We provide a theming layer and resource strings that can be overridden. We typically allow UI-level rebrand for OEMs while including a small legal attribution in About.

4) Pilot scope (sprint plan):
   - Week 0: provisioning and install checklist (access to test appliance + model snapshot)
   - Week 1–4: integration + latency tuning + small-scale pilot (1 tenant)
   - Month 2–3: scale validation, security review, draft MOU

Open questions for kickoff: preferred commercial model (rev-share vs. upfront licensing), support SLA for pilot vs. GA, and whether LumenAI will want exclusive territory for the pilot customer.

Attachments: redwood-embed-technical-appendix.pdf

—Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@lumenai.com>, Michael Dunn <michael.dunn@lumenai.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Commercial guardrails and example commercial terms (pilot + pilot-to-GA)

Hi Elena — following up with the commercial guardrails we typically propose for OEM/embedded partners. High level:

- Pilot (3 months): no revenue share; Redwood provides a reduced support bundle (SLA best-effort) and limited complimentary runtime usage for the pilot tenant.
- GA commercial options:
   Option A — Rev share: 15% of net revenue for usage-based product lines, 10% for seat/licensing lines.
   Option B — License + usage: one-time platform license fee (negotiable) + discounted per-token runtime rate.
- Co-sell: joint logos, joint case studies, and partner enablement materials; we ask for a mutual reference clause limited to specific customers.
- IP/branding: Redwood permits UI theming and removals of product logo in the shipped UI; legal attribution in About and in contracts is standard.

I can draft a short MOU and a pilot statement of work (SOW) that maps support levels and timelines if we agree on the model. Please let me know which commercial path you prefer so I can tailor the draft.

—Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft_mou_template.docx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@lumenai.com>

Subject: Re: Exploring embedded Redwood runtime in LumenAI — commercial & technical kickoff

Thanks everyone — this is helpful and exactly the level of detail we needed. Quick answers:
- Commercial: happy to pilot under the Pilot terms described (no rev-share during pilot). Post-pilot we prefer Option A (rev share). Our finance team will want a worked example for expected unit economics — happy to model that with your pricing team.
- Telemetry: we require the default local-only telemetry; customer consents will manage any bundles.
- Pilot customer: the EU customer has strict data residency rules; we’ll share their SOC2 checklist before the kickoff.

Request: can Redwood provide a draft MOU and a short SOW this week so our legal/compliance can start a parallel review before the kickoff? We’ll confirm Wed 11/17 2:00pm PT meeting.

Looking forward — Elena
